recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If this ever regresses in generated schema output, investigate the kindling generator rather than changing unrelated core source or adding prose.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 change request reporting that generated fhir-base.xsd had xs:minLength facets on unsignedInt-primitive and positiveInt-primitive, where those facets were not allowed.
initial_application: Jira records the resolution as fix and includes an editor comment saying the issue was already fixed. No current git commit explicitly references FHIR-6862, and current history shows the old in-repository XSD generator was later moved out to the kindling dependency.
additional_context: FHIR-7692 is a Duplicate issue with the same fhir-base.xsd report. The current checkout documents fhir-base.xsd as a generated schema artifact and depends on org.hl7.fhir:kindling; it has no checked-in fhir-base.xsd or local primitive XSD generator source. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting or clarifying discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current build.fhir.org fhir-base.xsd defines unsignedInt-primitive using xs:nonNegativeInteger plus a numeric pattern and positiveInt-primitive using xs:positiveInteger plus a numeric pattern, with no xs:minLength on either primitive.
